description.value: Chef's Kebab is an Indian restaurant on Fraser Highway in Surrey serving an extensive menu of authentic kebabs, curries, and biryanis, with breakfast items like Chole Puri and Paranthas rounding out the all-day offering. The menu spans lamb, chicken, seafood, and vegetarian dishes, with rotating daily specials that keep regulars coming back. Online ordering, delivery, and full catering services are all available.

The offers page explicitly states orders are valid for 'dine-in, takeout, and delivery orders', confirming takeout. The catering page lists 'Indian Vegetarian' as a menu option and the regular menu includes Daal Makhani, confirming vegetarian options. No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities.
